title: Risk-Aware Adaptive Evaluation: Finding High-Impact Failures Under Limited Budgets
abstract: arXiv:2609.38914v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating interactive agents is expensive. Agent behavior is stochastic, so reliability must be measured over repeated trials, but failures are rare and differ widely in how much they matter. Standard benchmarks spend this budget uniformly: a read-only lookup is sampled as often as an irreversible payment action. We instead formulate evaluation as a sequential allocation problem. Given a fixed trial budget and a set of scenarios whose failure behavior is unknown, which scenarios should be run, and run again? We propose a risk-aware contextual Thompson Sampling policy that combines a pre-execution scenario context vector and a fixed impact score with the failure outcomes observed during evaluation, and we test it by offline replay over 70 $\tau$-bench airline scenarios and 824 recorded trials. translated_title: 风险感知的自适应评估：在有限预算下发现高影响力故障
translated_abstract: 评估交互式智能体的代价高昂。智能体的行为具有随机性，因此必须通过多次重复试验来衡量其可靠性，但故障不仅罕见，其重要程度也差异巨大。标准基准测试均匀地分配评估预算：一次只读查询与一次不可逆的支付动作被以相同的频率抽样。我们将评估问题重新形式化为一个序列分配问题：在固定试验预算下，面对一组故障行为未知的场景，应该运行哪些场景？又应该重复运行哪些场景？我们提出了一种风险感知的上下文汤普森抽样（Thompson Sampling）策略，该策略将执行前的场景上下文向量与固定的影响分数相结合，并利用评估过程中观察到的故障结果进行更新。我们通过对70个τ-bench航空场景和824条记录试验进行离线回放来测试该方法。我们的主要结果体现在最小预算情形下：仅使用50次试验（占语料库的6%），该策略即可恢复86%按影响加权后的故障。
tldr: 提出一种风险感知的上下文汤普森抽样评估策略，仅需6%的试验预算即可恢复86%按影响加权的故障，大幅提升交互式智能体评估的效率。
en_tdlr: We propose a risk-aware contextual Thompson Sampling policy that recovers 86% of impact-weighted failures with only 6% of the trial budget, greatly improving the efficiency of evaluating interactive agents.
